messages:
rebecca_sales: Customer (MedArch Europe) ping — wants SOC 2 + ISO artifacts and to run a full pen test during the POC. Also asked for EU data residency and whether Dedicated pricing is needed. Can someone confirm the checklist we should send?

ana_security: We can support but need the formal intake + a vendor pen-test authorization letter. Send them the security intake link: https://redwood.internal/sec-intake-eu. Required artifacts: SOC2 report or SOC2 Type II summary, ISO27001 certificate, control mapping (how our controls meet their questionnaire), and contact for their tester.

rebecca_sales: They specifically asked whether a full red-team scan can hit Hosted.

ana_security: Short answer: no for full intrusive tests on Hosted. Hosted only allows non-intrusive scans (external unauthenticated scanning, CVE checks). For authenticated or intrusive tests (exploit attempts, DoS, source-code-aware testing) we require Dedicated or Private. If they insist EU residency + intrusive testing, propose EU Dedicated.

devin_se: For the Dedicated POC we need: model family, qps, concurrency, avg token lengths, expected workload mix (gen/embeddings/rerank), and whether they need KV cache persistence across sessions. Also staging CIDRs and expected test window. Provisioning ETA ~2 weeks after signed order and network approvals.

matt_finance: Pricing note: 30-day Dedicated POC = 40% of monthly reserved rate, one-time setup. If they require guaranteed burst add ~10% premium. If they want a shorter trial (2 weeks) we pro-rate. I can prepare a quote template.

ops_bot: Automated: presigned S3 upload links are supported for evidence delivery. See: https://redwood.internal/ops/presigned-evidence. Expiration defaults to 7 days; request alternate expiry in the intake.

ana_security: Pen-test authorization template - ask customer to supply vendor letter with these minimum fields:

```
Vendor name and contact
Scope: explicit hostnames/IPs and exact time window
Allowed techniques: list (e.g. authenticated scans, exploit attempts, DoS excluded)
Data handling: confirmation no production secrets retained, how artifacts are delivered
Points of contact (customer + our security contact)
Signed authorized rep (name, title, date)
```

ana_security: Also request their insurance limit and whether they need our Pen-test Addendum signed. For EU Dedicated we require 72h notice before any intrusive activity and we will run an internal pre-test review.

rebecca_sales: Proposed reply to customer (short checklist): 1) Complete intake URL, 2) Upload SOC2/ISO artifacts, 3) Provide vendor pen-test letter (use their template or ours), 4) Confirm EU region + BYOK/KMS preference, 5) Provide tech details for Dedicated sizing, 6) Let us know preferred test window. Can I send this?

matt_finance: Yes. I'll attach a provisional quote with the 40% POC rate and an optional burst line item.

devin_se: I'll draft the minimal provisioning checklist we need and add network/CIDR fields.

rebecca_sales: Great — I'll send the checklist + attach pen-test template and quote. Can we aim to have the proposal ready by EOD so they can review before their vendor schedules testing next week? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
